_meta.name: sem-invariance-ladder-for-each
_meta.description: The measurement-invariance ladder written ONCE in a single request: one multi-group MAT_SEM spec (the three-factor CFA of brand_survey.pulse across its two waves) carries a for_each that zips the step name [configural, metric, scalar] with the parameters held equal ["", "loadings", "loadings,intercepts"], so it expands in place into three matrix results named configural, metric and scalar. Each rendered spec takes its name from the step axis and its group_equal from the eq axis, spliced type-preserving by a $var marker. Compare chi2, dof, cfi and rmsea result to result: dof rises step by step as loadings, then intercepts, are held equal, and a small chi2 rise per degree of freedom gained supports the stricter step. Predict reports the fan-out at matrices[0] and counts the two added results against MaxExpandedItems.

params.model:
quality =~ q1 + q2 + q3
value =~ v1 + v2 + v3
service =~ s1 + s2 + s3
